metadata.title: Yau-type gradient estimates for p-harmonic functions on Riemannian manifolds with boundary under Dirichlet boundary condition
metadata.abstract: A Yau-type gradient estimate is proved for positive $p$-harmonic functions on complete Riemannian manifolds with compact boundary, under a Ricci lower bound on the Riemannian manifold and a mean curvature lower bound on the boundary, assuming the Dirichlet condition and a sign condition on the outward normal derivative. The result extends the estimate for harmonic functions by Kunikawa and Sakurai to the full range of $p$-Laplace operators and yields a Liouville theorem when the curvature hypotheses are nonnegative. The cutoff method of the linear theory does not extend when the exponent differs from two, since it requires a directional Hessian of the distance to the boundary that Laplacian comparison cannot control. That cutoff is replaced here by a radial barrier at the boundary and an intrinsic maximum principle in the interior.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对紧边界完备流形上的正 p-调和函数，在 Ricci 和边界平均曲率下界、Dirichlet 条件及外法导数符号条件下建立 Yau 型估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 绕过线性截断法在 p≠2 时无法控制方向 Hessian 的障碍。
analysis.limitations: Liouville 推论仍依赖非负曲率及边界条件，不适用于任意正 p-调和函数。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
